after: ## The four stages, mapped to the four criteria
alt: A clockwise cycle of four stages, each assessed by one criterion: the problem stage (A, inquiring and analysing), the specification stage (B, developing ideas), the build stage (C, creating the solution) and the test stage (D, evaluating). The cycle is used for every project.
caption: Each criterion is one stage of the design cycle made assessable.

after: ## Worked example: applying the cycle to a design situation
alt: A storage solution for a small space moves through four stages: A inquire into the client’s need and existing solutions; B write a specification covering size, materials, budget and constraints and propose a solution; C plan and build a testable prototype; D test it objectively against the specification, name limitations and explain the impact on the client.
caption: Every stage of the project produces something a moderator can mark.

after: ## Documentation matters more than the finished product
alt: Two folders compared with schematic bars. A polished final product with thin documentation of inquiry, specification, process and evaluation typically scores lower. A rougher prototype backed by thorough documentation at every stage typically scores higher, because the ePortfolio is assessed as a complete design folder.
caption: A strong folder beats a polished object with little process behind it.

after: ## Honest evaluation is rewarded, not penalised
alt: Claiming the solution is already perfect and showing only what worked is contrasted with an honest evaluation: objective tests, real limitations named, and how the solution could be improved. Stage D rewards that transparency.
caption: Naming real weaknesses, with improvements, is what Stage D rewards.

after: ## Why the cycle repeats rather than runs once
alt: Three projects in a row, each running through stages A, B, C and D, with the criteria reassessed every time. Treating the cycle as a one-off introduction lets weak documentation habits persist; treating it as a working habit on every project lets them be corrected early.
caption: The design cycle is the structure for every project, not an introductory unit.

after: ## Design's role in the MYP certificate
alt: The MYP certificate requires satisfactory achievement in at least one of physical and health education, arts or design, so a well-documented design ePortfolio can decide whether that requirement is met. MYP design skills also lead into DP Design Technology, whose coursework uses the same cyclical process.
caption: Design can satisfy a certificate requirement, and the cycle carries on into the DP.
